name: Landlord Maintenance & Rent Escalation Dispute
place: Inside a rented apartment during an unannounced property inspection
role: You are a strict property landlord inspecting maintenance issues.
speaker: Landlord Mr. Sterling

tasks.goal: Identify maintenance issues requiring urgent repair
tasks.hint: List problems like leaks, broken heating, or electrical faults.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported specific property maintenance issues needing repair.

Japanese.goal: 急いで修理が必要な不具合を挙げる
Japanese.hint: 水漏れ、暖房の故障、電気の不具合などの問題を挙げましょう。

tasks.goal: Dispute recent notice of a sudden rent increase
tasks.hint: State that the proposed rent increase is unreasonable.
tasks.done_when: Learner contested a proposed rent increase notice.

Japanese.goal: 最近届いた急な家賃値上げの通知に異議を唱える
Japanese.hint: 提示された値上げは不当だと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Condition rent increase acceptance on immediate maintenance fixes
tasks.hint: Link rent adjustments to completed repairs.
tasks.done_when: Learner conditioned any rent adjustment on prompt completion of pending maintenance.

Japanese.goal: すぐに修理することを条件に家賃の値上げを受け入れる
Japanese.hint: 家賃の調整を修理の完了と結びつけましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'provision'
tasks.hint: A provision is a condition or requirement stated within a legal agreement. Cite the maintenance provision in your rental contract.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'provision'.

Japanese.goal: 「条項」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 条項とは、法的な契約の中に書かれた条件や決まりのことです。賃貸契約の修繕に関する条項を示しましょう。

tasks.goal: Point out local tenant rights and rent control limits
tasks.hint: Mention statutory limits on annual rent increases.
tasks.done_when: Learner cited tenant rights or legal rent increase caps.

Japanese.goal: 地域の借主の権利と家賃規制の上限を指摘する
Japanese.hint: 年間の家賃値上げに法律上の上限があることを伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Refuse unannounced landlord entries without 24-hour notice
tasks.hint: Politely enforce privacy rights under the lease.
tasks.done_when: Learner insisted on receiving formal 24-hour notice before landlord visits.

Japanese.goal: 二十四時間前の通知なしに大家が部屋に入ることを断る
Japanese.hint: 賃貸契約に基づくプライバシーの権利を丁寧に主張しましょう。

tasks.goal: Provide evidence of past maintenance requests sent in writing
tasks.hint: Show proof of earlier ignored requests.
tasks.done_when: Learner cited previous written notices regarding unresolved repairs.

Japanese.goal: 過去に書面で修理を依頼した証拠を見せる
Japanese.hint: 以前の依頼が無視されていた証拠を見せましょう。

tasks.goal: Request binding repair timeline for property issues
tasks.hint: Ask the landlord for a written schedule of when repairs will begin.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a clear schedule or timeline for property maintenance.
tasks.scene_hint: Water drips steadily into a bucket from a ceiling moisture stain.

Japanese.goal: 修理の期限を確約してもらうよう頼む
Japanese.hint: いつ修理を始めるのか、書面で予定を出してもらうよう大家に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Propose withholding partial rent in escrow until repairs are made
tasks.hint: Mention legal escrow mechanisms for unresolved health hazards.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed placing rent in escrow until critical repairs are completed.

Japanese.goal: 修理が終わるまで家賃の一部を第三者預託口座に預けることを提案する
Japanese.hint: 健康上の危険が解決されないときに使える、法的な預託の仕組みについて伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for written confirmation of repair completion dates
tasks.hint: Request a binding schedule from the landlord.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for written commitment on repair timelines.

Japanese.goal: 修理の完了日を書面で確認してもらうよう頼む
Japanese.hint: 大家に確約できる予定表を出してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate a lower rent increase percentage in exchange for lease extension
tasks.hint: Offer a longer lease term for a smaller increase.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered a longer lease extension in exchange for a capped rent increase.

Japanese.goal: 契約期間を延長する代わりに、家賃の値上げ率を下げてもらうよう交渉する
Japanese.hint: 値上げを小さくしてもらう代わりに、もっと長い契約期間を申し出ましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'withholding'
tasks.hint: Withholding refers to deducting or holding back funds from a payment. Ask about security deposit withholding rules upon move-out.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'withholding'.

Japanese.goal: 「支払い保留」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 支払い保留とは、支払うお金の一部を差し引いたり、支払わずにおいたりすることです。退去時に敷金の支払いを保留するルールについて尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Summarize agreed terms of rent and maintenance schedule
tasks.done_when: Learner summarized agreed rent terms and repair commitments.

Japanese.goal: 家賃と修理の予定について合意した条件をまとめる
Japanese.hint: 追加の書面に署名する前に、合意した内容を確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request a written addendum to the lease agreement
tasks.hint: Ask for formal documentation of the agreement.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a written addendum or document for the lease agreement.

Japanese.goal: 賃貸契約書に追加する書面を作ってもらうよう頼む
Japanese.hint: 合意内容を正式な書類にしてもらうようお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Conclude meeting professionally with the landlord
tasks.hint: Part on respectful, clear business terms.
tasks.done_when: Learner concluded the conversation professionally.

Japanese.goal: 大家との話し合いをきちんと締めくくる
Japanese.hint: 敬意を持って、はっきりした条件で話を終えましょう。

tasks.goal: Specify apartment unit number and lease start date
tasks.done_when: Learner stated unit number and lease inception date.

Japanese.goal: 部屋番号と契約の開始日を伝える
Japanese.hint: 物件を特定するための情報を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: State primary reason for requesting emergency landlord meeting
tasks.done_when: Learner stated primary meeting objective regarding rent and repairs.

Japanese.goal: 大家との緊急の話し合いを求めた主な理由を伝える
Japanese.hint: 問題の中心となる話題を説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Identify specific habitability hazards like toxic mold or heating failure
tasks.done_when: Learner detailed severe habitability or health hazards in unit.

Japanese.goal: 有害なカビや暖房の故障など、住むのに支障がある具体的な危険を挙げる
Japanese.hint: 建物の重大な欠陥を挙げましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm date for follow-up joint walkthrough inspection with landlord
tasks.done_when: Learner scheduled joint property walkthrough date.

Japanese.goal: 大家と一緒にもう一度部屋を確認する日を決める
Japanese.hint: 部屋の点検の日を決めましょう。

tasks.goal: Request signed written copy of maintenance repair schedule
tasks.done_when: Learner requested signed repair commitment timeline.

Japanese.goal: 署名入りの修理予定表を書面でもらうよう頼む
Japanese.hint: 大家に書面で確約してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm agreed rent increase percentage for upcoming lease renewal
tasks.done_when: Learner verified agreed renewal rent figure.

Japanese.goal: 次の契約更新での家賃の値上げ率を確認する
Japanese.hint: 新しい月々の家賃を最終決定しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request written addendum protecting tenant against future surprise fee hikes
tasks.done_when: Learner requested binding lease addendum document.

Japanese.goal: 今後の予告なしの料金値上げから借主を守る追加の書面を頼む
Japanese.hint: 法的な追加書面の草案をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm bank escrow account details for held rent funds
tasks.hint: Provide escrow bank info if applicable.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified rent escrow deposit account details.

Japanese.goal: 預けた家賃を入れる第三者預託口座の銀行情報を確認する
Japanese.hint: 必要であれば、預託口座の銀行情報を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Verify key exchange procedure for certified repair technicians
tasks.done_when: Learner verified access arrangements for maintenance crew.

Japanese.goal: 資格を持つ修理業者への鍵の受け渡し方法を確認する
Japanese.hint: 修理のときの部屋への立ち入り方法について合意しましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm receipt of formal tenant complaint log copy
tasks.hint: Ensure written record of complaints is retained.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed receipt of updated maintenance ticket history.

Japanese.goal: 借主からの正式な苦情記録の写しを受け取ったことを確認する
Japanese.hint: 苦情の記録が書面で残るようにしましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'clause'
tasks.hint: A clause is a specific section or provision within a contract. Cite the repair timeline clause in your rental agreement.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'clause'.

Japanese.goal: 「条項」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 条項とは、契約の中の特定の部分や決まりのことです。賃貸契約の修理期限に関する条項を示しましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'escrow'
tasks.hint: Escrow means holding funds in a neutral account until conditions are met. Propose rent escrow.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'escrow'.

Japanese.goal: 「エスクロー」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: エスクローとは、条件が満たされるまで中立の口座にお金を預けておくことです。家賃をエスクローで預けることを提案しましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'addendum'
tasks.hint: Addendum means an addition or amendment to a contract. Request a lease addendum.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'addendum'.

Japanese.goal: 「追加条項」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 追加条項とは、契約に付け加えたり修正したりする部分のことです。賃貸契約への追加条項をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Dispute landlord claim that tenant caused plumbing blockage
tasks.hint: Provide plumber report attributing failure to aging pipes.
tasks.done_when: Learner refuted plumbing damage blame using professional report.
tasks.scene_hint: A rusted section of pipe sits on newspaper beside the opened cabinet doors.

Japanese.goal: 排水管の詰まりは借主のせいだという大家の主張に異議を唱える
Japanese.hint: 配管の老朽化が原因だとする配管業者の報告書を見せましょう。

tasks.goal: Condition lease renewal signing on replacement of broken refrigerator
tasks.hint: Link lease extension to appliance update.
tasks.done_when: Learner insisted on appliance replacement before signing renewal.
tasks.scene_hint: A rusty radiator clinks loudly as paint flakes from the bedroom wall.

Japanese.goal: 壊れた冷蔵庫の交換を契約更新の署名の条件にする
Japanese.hint: 契約の延長を家電の交換と結びつけましょう。

tasks.goal: Request rent credit for days apartment was rendered uninhabitable
tasks.done_when: Learner requested rent credit for unlivable days.
tasks.scene_hint: Cold draft air whistles through unsealed window frames in the living room.

Japanese.goal: 部屋に住めなかった日数分の家賃を減額してもらうよう頼む
Japanese.hint: 日割りで家賃を割り引いてもらうようお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Point out that proposed fifteen percent rent increase violates local caps
tasks.done_when: Learner cited local rent control percentage limits.
tasks.scene_hint: Faint noise from creaking floorboards echoes through the stairwell outside.

Japanese.goal: 十五パーセントの家賃値上げは地域の上限に違反していると指摘する
Japanese.hint: 市の家賃安定化の上限を示しましょう。

tasks.goal: Demand immediate repair of broken exterior door lock for safety
tasks.done_when: Learner demanded urgent security lock replacement.
tasks.scene_hint: Dust motes float past cracked hallway plaster under dim light bulbs.

Japanese.goal: 安全のため、壊れた玄関ドアの鍵をすぐに直すよう求める
Japanese.hint: 建物の防犯に関する大家の義務を主張しましょう。

tasks.goal: Offer to arrange licensed electrician repair and deduct cost from rent
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed repair-and-deduct option for electrical work.
tasks.scene_hint: A warped wooden cabinet door hangs loosely from rusted hinges.

Japanese.goal: 資格を持つ電気工事士に修理を頼み、その費用を家賃から差し引くことを申し出る
Japanese.hint: 自分で修理して費用を差し引く方法を提案しましょう。

tasks.goal: Dispute landlord assessment of carpet wear and tear
tasks.done_when: Learner argued carpet wear constitutes normal depreciation.
tasks.scene_hint: A moisture meter beeps against damp drywall near the bathroom shower.

Japanese.goal: カーペットの傷みについての大家の判断に異議を唱える
Japanese.hint: 損傷ではなく、普通に使っていて古くなっただけだと主張しましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if landlord carries property liability insurance for water damage
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about landlord insurance for tenant property damage.
tasks.scene_hint: Peeling wallpaper curls along the kitchen baseboards.

Japanese.goal: 大家が水濡れ被害に対応する賠償責任保険に入っているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 建物の保険の補償内容について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Request 48-hour written notice prior to non-emergency maintenance visits
tasks.done_when: Learner requested mandatory advance written entry notice.
tasks.scene_hint: Squeaky elevator cables groan behind the apartment entry wall.

Japanese.goal: 緊急でない修理で訪問する場合は四十八時間前に書面で通知するよう頼む
Japanese.hint: 借主のプライバシーを守るための線引きを主張しましょう。

tasks.goal: Propose fixed two-year lease extension to freeze annual rent hikes
tasks.hint: Offer long term for price stability.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed multi-year lease for capped rent rates.
tasks.scene_hint: A portable space heater hums on the hardwood floor.

Japanese.goal: 毎年の家賃値上げを止めるため、二年間の定期契約延長を提案する
Japanese.hint: 家賃を安定させるため、長期の契約を申し出ましょう。

tasks.goal: Demand formal exterminator treatment for recurring pest infestation
tasks.done_when: Learner demanded pest eradication services by licensed firm.
tasks.scene_hint: A water stain ring expands slowly across the acoustic ceiling tile.

Japanese.goal: 繰り返し発生する害虫について、専門業者による駆除を求める
Japanese.hint: 専門の害虫駆除をしてもらうよう求めましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for written breakdown of utility cost allocations for shared meters
tasks.done_when: Learner requested utility cost allocation formulas.
tasks.scene_hint: A radiator control valve drips onto an old metal tray.

Japanese.goal: 共用メーターの光熱費の配分を書面で詳しく示してもらうよう頼む
Japanese.hint: 個別メーターでの計算方法について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Explain that written notices sent via email were ignored for three months
tasks.hint: Provide paper trail of ignored requests.
tasks.done_when: Learner presented documented history of unanswered repair emails.

Japanese.goal: メールで送った書面の通知が三か月間無視されていたと説明する
Japanese.hint: 無視された依頼の記録を見せましょう。

tasks.goal: Dispute landlord claim that noise complaints justify non-renewal
tasks.hint: Refute noise allegations with tenant log.
tasks.done_when: Learner contested baseless noise complaint accusations.

Japanese.goal: 騒音の苦情を理由に契約を更新しないという大家の主張に異議を唱える
Japanese.hint: 借主の記録を使って、騒音の指摘に反論しましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify security deposit interest payment requirements under local law
tasks.done_when: Learner requested annual security deposit interest calculation.

Japanese.goal: 地域の法律で敷金の利息を支払う義務があるか確認する
Japanese.hint: たまった利息を支払ってもらうようお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: State that window safety guards are mandatory for families with young children
tasks.done_when: Learner demanded installation of legal window safety guards.

Japanese.goal: 小さい子どもがいる家庭には窓の転落防止柵が義務だと伝える
Japanese.hint: 子どもの安全に関する住宅の基準を示しましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if sub-leasing is permitted during extended work assignments
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about subleasing rights under existing contract.

Japanese.goal: 長期の出張中に部屋を又貸ししてもよいか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 又貸しのルールについて尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Dispute late rent fee imposed during bank processing delay
tasks.hint: Request waiver of unfair penalty fee.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested waiver of late fee caused by banking delay.

Japanese.goal: 銀行の処理の遅れで発生した家賃の延滞料に異議を唱える
Japanese.hint: 不当な延滞料を免除してもらうようお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if landlord provides window air conditioner unit maintenance
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about landlord responsibilities for AC units.

Japanese.goal: 窓用エアコンの手入れを大家がしてくれるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 冷房設備の手入れについて尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify policy on parking space assignment changes
tasks.hint: Ask if designated parking spot is protected.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified reserved parking spot rights.

Japanese.goal: 駐車場の区画を変更する場合の方針を確認する
Japanese.hint: 決められた駐車スペースが守られるか尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about tenant rights regarding common area cleaning frequency
tasks.done_when: Learner requested improved maintenance of shared stairwells and lobby.

Japanese.goal: 共用部分の掃除の頻度について借主の権利を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ロビーの清掃の基準について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Dispute trash collection fee increase added to monthly rent invoice
tasks.done_when: Learner questioned unbudgeted utility or trash surcharge fees.

Japanese.goal: 月々の家賃の請求書に追加されたゴミ収集費の値上げに異議を唱える
Japanese.hint: 予告なしに追加された料金に異議を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Request copy of building fire safety and evacuation plan
tasks.done_when: Learner requested building fire evacuation guidelines.

Japanese.goal: 建物の防火対策と避難計画の写しを頼む
Japanese.hint: 安全に関する書類をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about pet deposit refundability conditions upon move-out
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified pet deposit terms and refund criteria.

Japanese.goal: 退去時にペット用の敷金が返金される条件について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ペットの料金の条件について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Propose painting apartment walls at tenant expense with landlord color approval
tasks.done_when: Learner offered to paint apartment subject to color consent.

Japanese.goal: 大家に色を承認してもらった上で、借主の負担で部屋の壁を塗り替えることを提案する
Japanese.hint: 部屋の見た目をよくすることを申し出ましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm key duplication policy for family members
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about key copy permission for relatives.

Japanese.goal: 家族用の合鍵を作る場合の方針を確認する
Japanese.hint: 追加の鍵を作る許可について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about package delivery room security cameras
tasks.hint: Ask about parcel safety in lobby.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about security monitoring in mailroom.

Japanese.goal: 宅配便の保管室の防犯カメラについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ロビーでの荷物の安全について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm laundry room machine operation schedules and pricing
tasks.done_when: Learner verified laundry room access hours and washing fees.

Japanese.goal: ランドリールームの洗濯機の利用時間と料金を確認する
Japanese.hint: 洗濯設備のルールについて尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if storage locker in basement is included in base rent
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed basement storage locker assignment.

Japanese.goal: 地下の収納スペースが基本の家賃に含まれているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 追加の収納スペースの割り当てを確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request installation of smoke detector batteries during inspection
tasks.done_when: Learner requested smoke alarm battery replacement.

Japanese.goal: 点検のときに煙探知機の電池を入れてもらうよう頼む
Japanese.hint: 安全装置の整備をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about bicycle storage rack availability in courtyard
tasks.hint: Ask where bikes can be locked.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about designated bicycle parking areas.

Japanese.goal: 中庭に自転車置き場があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 自転車をどこに止めて鍵をかけられるか尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm guest stay limits specified in lease terms
tasks.done_when: Learner verified maximum allowed consecutive guest stay days.

Japanese.goal: 賃貸契約で決められている来客の滞在の上限を確認する
Japanese.hint: 来客が泊まれる期間のルールをはっきりさせましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for contact number of emergency maintenance technician on duty
tasks.done_when: Learner requested 24/7 emergency repair telephone hotline.

Japanese.goal: 当番の緊急修理担当者の連絡先を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 営業時間外の連絡先について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm building quiet hours rules specified in house policy
tasks.done_when: Learner verified evening quiet hours policy.

Japanese.goal: 建物の決まりで定められている静かにする時間帯を確認する
Japanese.hint: 騒音を控える時間帯を確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if online rent payment portal charges processing fees
tasks.done_when: Learner checked digital payment transaction fees.

Japanese.goal: オンラインの家賃支払いサイトに手数料がかかるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 支払いサイトの費用について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm recycling sorting guidelines for building waste bins
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about building recycling waste rules.

Japanese.goal: 建物のゴミ箱でのリサイクルの分別方法を確認する
Japanese.hint: ゴミの分別のルールを確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Request confirmation of lease expiration date in writing
tasks.done_when: Learner verified exact lease end date for planning.

Japanese.goal: 契約の満了日を書面で確認してもらうよう頼む
Japanese.hint: 契約の終了日を確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about window screen installation and repair policy
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about landlord repair obligations for window screens.

Japanese.goal: 網戸の取り付けと修理の方針について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 網戸の手入れについて尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm procedure for reporting emergency water pipe leaks after hours
tasks.done_when: Learner verified emergency contact protocol for plumbing leaks.

Japanese.goal: 営業時間外に水道管から緊急の水漏れがあった場合の連絡手順を確認する
Japanese.hint: 緊急時の連絡の手順を尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if tenant union meetings are permitted in building common room
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about common room usage rights for tenant meetings.

Japanese.goal: 建物の共用ルームで借主の組合の集まりを開いてもよいか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 借主が団結して活動する権利について尋ねましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm expected processing timeline for security deposit return post move-out
tasks.done_when: Learner verified security deposit refund timeline under state law.

Japanese.goal: 退去後に敷金が返ってくるまでの期間の目安を確認する
Japanese.hint: 敷金がどれくらいで返ってくるか尋ねましょう。

name_translations.Japanese: 大家との修繕・家賃値上げのトラブル

place_translations.Japanese: 抜き打ち点検中の賃貸アパート
